definitions.explanation: Work done by hand rather than by machine. Refers to both the activity and the resulting product, often with a connotation of skilled craftsmanship and warmth.

examples.japanese: {手仕事|てしごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温|あたた}かみ→温かみ：25336_atatakami⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手仕事|てしごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧だった。
examples.english: My grandmother was good at handicraft.

examples.japanese: ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧{手仕事|てしごと}ならで⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わい：11899_ajiwai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a unique charm to handwork that machines cannot produce.

notes:
Combines ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ (work). Carries a positive connotation, emphasizing the human touch and craftsmanship that distinguishes handmade items from mass-produced ones. Often used when discussing traditional crafts, artisan work, or home crafts like knitting and sewing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手仕事|てしごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温|あたた}かみ→温かみ：25336_atatakami⟧ — the warmth of handmade work
- {手仕事|てしごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧ — handcrafted item
- ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧な{手仕事|てしごと} — careful handiwork

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧ — handmade; focuses on the homemade quality of something
- ⟦{手芸|しゅげい}→手芸：07062_shugei⟧ — needlework, textile crafts; specifically sewing, knitting, embroidery
- ⟦{工芸|こうげい}→工芸：04182_kougei⟧ — arts and crafts; refers to skilled decorative or fine arts
